access_routes.required_action: An authorized user must establish CDS access, obtain a personal API token and manually review/accept applicable dataset terms. No account action, licence acceptance or request submission was performed.

access_routes.route: ECMWF native ERA5 ARCO geo-chunked stores and CDS time-series subset service
access_routes.gate: Official documentation specifies a CDS API key in the Authorization Bearer header. The time-series form also requires login and terms acceptance. No unauthenticated bypass or credential use attempted.

access_routes.edition: Google-repackaged ERA5 atmospheric reanalysis on a regular 0.25-degree grid; not ERA5-Land. Store name ends zarr-v3 but the inspected array encoding is Zarr format 2.
access_routes.requested_period_edition: 2021 falls within the provider's stable ERA5 interval, not the ERA5T tail; fields were not downloaded or decoded.
access_routes.boundary_object_HEAD_status: Eight HTTP 200 responses for the four fields at candidate first/last indices derived from metadata origin; coordinate values not decoded.
access_routes.gate: Even the first candidate hour's four compressed whole-grid objects exceed 10 MB. Ordinary Zarr point selection still reads whole spatial chunks. No block-level range decoder was verified within this investigation; no weather chunks downloaded.

access_routes.edition: ERA5 downloaded from CDS, conservatively regridded by the mirror provider; 1.5-degree spatial grid and six-hourly samples. Not ERA5-Land and not local station weather.
access_routes.gate: The documented 0.25-degree hourly mirror also uses global spatial chunks. The smaller 1.5-degree mirror would change temporal/spatial coverage: its regular grid has no centre inside the existing prepared local box. Nearest coarse-cell selection would expand spatial support. No coarse substitute, interpolation, completeness claim or licence acceptance was made; weather values and coordinate arrays remain unverified.

The official alternatives page notes cloud-provider open-data history starting in January 2022. This does not establish availability for September 2021; no forecast dates or availability timestamps substituted.

retrospective_use_limits: Reanalysis validity time is not publication time or actor receipt time. There is no acquired weather series, observation-derived local wind, humidity derivation or simulator bridge in this sidecar.
